note: temporal.IsCanceledError(err) after a child workflow failed is a decision (true: cancelled). The call outcome table lists "cancelled" as a kind of failure of the child workflow call.

paths.text: Start -> Child (child workflow) --failure--> if temporal.IsCanceledError(err) --true--> End (completed)
Start -> Child (child workflow) --failure--> if temporal.IsCanceledError(err) --false--> End (failed)
